item.title: Fashion retailer with locations at central Ohio malls reportedly closing all stores
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (WCMH) – Women’s fashion retailer Francesca’s, a staple at multiple central Ohio malls, is reportedly preparing to close all of its stores nationwide.
